_doc: Lake Murray north piece C (mission_gorge, Mission Gorge Road): the road's two outer edges per station off the USGS 2024 lidar (north_curbs_g10.py; the method is its docstring), against the built edges. u = metres off the piece's line, + = left of travel along increasing s. left / right: verdict face / none / unclear; type curb, edge (rise) or edge (drop); face_u_m, unc_m (half the interval between the neighbouring returns the face lies between), step_m (outer - road at the face; negative for a drop); cant_call: why a side gives no face. built = the piece's own row (left_m, right_m; middle their mean, width their difference). real_middle_m / real_width_m from the two faces; *_minus_built_m = real minus built. Settings marked [invented] in the script are the method's choices, not measurements.

frame.projection: shrub_heights.Track.to_local: pyproj EPSG 6340 -> 4326 ('Inverse of UTM zone 11N + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)', stated accuracy 2.0 m), then the WGS84 metres-per-degree series at the origin

travel_bearing_deg.what: the piece's tangent along increasing s, degrees from north

road_at_line_minus_y3dep_m.what: the lidar road within 0.5 m of the piece's line (last returns, OUT_Q percentile, grade out) minus the row's y_3dep, engine y

summary._doc: over the stations this file measured (not the check stations). A 25 m bin is called for a quantity with 5+ stations reading it and their IQR at most 1.0 m. built_off_over_1m / built_within_0_3m: runs of consecutive called bins whose median real-minus-built is over 1 m / under 0.3 m in size; bin_medians_m the range of those bins' medians, stations_median_m the median over the run's stations. station_runs_*: per station the running median of the readings within +-12.5 m (3+ of them), runs of consecutive stations where it is over 1 m / under 0.3 m in size (finer than the bins). unmeasured: stations whose side gives no face, by can't-call category (junction mouth names in the stations and per_25m).
